doc_title: Castellow Wexcombe Multi-Manager Fund, L.P. Confidential Private Offering Memorandum
notes: An open-end fund of hedge funds memorandum in which the Partnership's own economics (1.00% management fee, 10% incentive allocation over a 5.00% hard hurdle) sit directly beside a paragraph of higher Portfolio Fund fees (1.50% to 2.00% and 15% to 20%, weighted averages 1.62% and 18.4%) and a 2.86% aggregate layered figure. Section 2.4 gives Portfolio Fund liquidity terms (30 to 90 days' notice, one to three year hard or soft locks, 10% to 20% fund or investor gates) ahead of the fund's own 95-day notice, one-year soft lock and 25% investor-level gate. The adviser's voluntary $7.25 million holding is expressly not a commitment, the only MFN rights run from Portfolio Funds to the Partnership, a custodian is named but no prime broker, and principals are named without any key person provision.

traps.management_fee: Section 4.4 places Portfolio Fund management fees of 1.50% to 2.00% (weighted average 1.62%) beside the fund's own fee and Section 8.1 gives a 2.86% aggregate; the correct answer is the Partnership's own 1.00% per annum of capital account NAV, payable quarterly in advance.
traps.performance_fee: Portfolio Fund performance fees of 15% to 20% (up to 30%, weighted average 18.4%) sit next to the Partnership's own incentive allocation; the correct answer is 10% of Excess Net Profits to the General Partner.
traps.hurdle_rate: Section 4.4 says Portfolio Fund performance fees usually have no hurdle or a Treasury-linked one; the Partnership's own hurdle in Section 4.3 is 5.00% per annum, hard, with no catch-up.
traps.gp_commitment: Section 3.2 discloses an affiliate holding of about $7.25 million (about 1.9% of NAV) but states no commitment is required and the holding is not a commitment of any kind, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE rather than the holding.
traps.prime_broker: Section 7.3 names a custodian and says Portfolio Funds choose their own prime brokers, but expressly states the Partnership does not engage a prime broker, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE (NOT_FOUND also accepted).
traps.key_man_provision: Principals are named in Sections 2.2, 3.1 and 8.3 and a risk factor says losing them could hurt the fund, but there is no key person provision or trigger anywhere, so the answer is NOT_FOUND.
traps.mfn_election: Section 9.2 describes most favored nation rights the Partnership obtains from 14 Portfolio Funds, but expressly offers Limited Partners no MFN election, so the answer is NOT_APPLICABLE.
